generated_for: Guru Shapes official named standup catalog
source: https://gurushapes.com (official Shopify shop and /pages/model-* overviews — excludes tees, used boards, and custom-order deposits)

brands.name: Guru Shapes
brands.short_description: Handcrafted surfboards by Oscar Guruceaga in Oceanside, California — performance shortboards, fish, mid-lengths, and longboards shaped one at a time.

models.name: ABRACADABRAH
models.description: An alternative shortboard that does things the mainstream can't. Channels are optional. Built as a user-friendly, ultra-performance craft. Size range 5'2"–6'2". Fin setup: tri, quad, or five-box. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Elegante
models.description: One California Board. Classic lines, modern performance. Built for style, powerful carves, point-wave trim, and everything in between. Size range 7'–9'+. Fin setup: 2+1 or single. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Formula CT
models.description: Championship Tour DNA. Precision performance for advanced surfers who demand the most from their equipment. Size range 5'4"–6'4". Fin setup: tri. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: KO
models.description: Fast and responsive. A heavy-water log built for serious noserides and powerful trim lines — Oscar's go-to for California point breaks. Size range 9'–10'+. Fin setup: single. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Kool Aid 2.0
models.description: The KOOL-AID 2.0 is a cornerstone of the lineup, reimagined with a sleeker, more foiled nose and tail that keeps volume only where it counts. Complex bottom contours and low-apex rails deliver glide and rail-to-rail engagement; the Twinzer setup makes it an electrifying mid-length. Size range 6'6"–8'. Fin setup: 2+1 or tri. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Kool-Aid Jammer
models.description: The Kool-Aid taken further — shortboard sizes, less volume, more spice, same infectious feel. Size range 5'2"–6'. Fin setup: tri or quad. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Palo Santo
models.description: A soulful longboard with smooth, flowing character. Built to glide, yet noserides like a champ — for longboarders who want something slick or shortboarders who want to slow down and stay connected. Size range 9'2"–10"+. Fin setup: single. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: Pisces
models.description: Oscar's take on the new-age San Diego fish, blending classic roots with a refined, tapered nose and tail. A subtle tri-plane bottom, deep concave between the fins, and low-apex rails keep it fast and maneuverable. Designed for hybrid keels. Size range 5'–6'. Oscar's personal daily driver. Handcrafted in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: REVO
models.description: A high-performance shortboard on a longer rail line — more length and drive than a standard shortboard, with no loss of snap. Reverse vee bottom (traced to Maurice Cole) rolls rail to rail and holds through the pocket. Swallowtail with wings plus twin-plus-trailer blends a twin's speed with a thruster's hold. Size range 5'6"–6'6". Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.

models.name: The Endless
models.description: A Guru Shapes × Mike Hynson longboard drawn from a rare Hynson semi-gun shaped for Blacks Beach. Long and narrower, yet it turns and glides like a board half its size — fast, responsive, and fun from three feet to twelve-plus. Size range 9'–10'+. Fin setup: single or 2+1. Handcrafted by Oscar in Oceanside, CA.
